I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

On 2025-09-03, Pree posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. When she closed the incident at 18:43, she said Southgate had cleared the backlog. I told him the channel doesn't give a city or address for Southgate.

I only used that channel, and Tobias is a member of it, so nothing he couldn't already see went into the reply.
